definitions.gloss: heat level; heat control; temperature (of cooking fire/stove)
definitions.explanation: The degree of heat used in cooking. Refers to the skill of adjusting and maintaining the right temperature for various cooking techniques.

examples.japanese: {火加減|ひかげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧⟦しながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧。
examples.english: Simmer while adjusting the heat level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中火|ちゅうび}→中火：08169_chuubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{火加減|ひかげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}いて→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{火加減|ひかげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しくて→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{焦|こ}がして→焦がす：06677_kogasu⟧⟦しまう→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: Heat control is difficult, so I often burn things.

notes:
HEAT LEVELS IN JAPANESE:
- ⟦{強火|つよび}→強火：08170_tsuyobi⟧ (high heat)
- ⟦{中火|ちゅうび}→中火：08169_chuubi⟧ (medium heat)
- ⟦{弱火|よわび}→弱火：08168_yowabi⟧ (low heat)
- ⟦とろ{火|び}→とろ火：08577_torobi⟧ (very low heat/simmer)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {火加減|ひかげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to adjust the heat)
- {火加減|ひかげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to check the heat level)
- {火加減|ひかげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧ (heat control is difficult)

COOKING CONTEXT:
Proper {火加減|ひかげん} is considered essential for Japanese cooking, where subtle temperature control affects texture and flavor. Recipes often specify exact heat levels.

WRITING:
- ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧ (fire) + ⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧ (adjustment/degree) = degree of fire → heat level

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{塩加減|しおかげん}→塩加減：08575_shiokagen⟧ (salt level/seasoning with salt)

cross_references.note: the same 〜加減 pattern for salt
